title: Esrbespoke statement
description: A tiny capital label at the top and, a long way below it, one big paragraph set solid across the whole width (40px on desktop, 20px on phones): the site's statement section, on paper, black or charcoal. The page-top variant opens a page under the header with the paragraph alone, typing its letters on as it loads.
notes: placement="page-top" leaves room for the absolute header and types the text on (that part needs JavaScript; without it the text is simply shown)
name: esrbespoke-statement

props.name: label
props.description: the tiny label at the top (wraps at about 10rem)

props.name: placement
props.description: "section": label, then the paragraph far below it; "page-top": the paragraph opens the page under the header
